coverageRule: Every generated Case copies the axis requirementIds and binds all A001 through A008 assertions of its planned Oracle; additional requirement edges may be added only when semantically exact.
noFallbackRule: All defaults and overrides are resolved in this file. Generators and executors may not read group defaults, wildcard mappings, latest manifests, or ambient values.
identityReservationRule: plannedOracleId and caseId are reserved only; identity issuance occurs solely when the immutable JSONL record is appended after all gates pass.
